audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror (audits/top/mel__yorick). Yorick's page read Mel, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Mel, Yorick, Yorick; Mel's page reads Skill, Mel, Mel, Mel, Skill, Yorick, Yorick.
audit.why: Mel is a 950/1000-range mage whose Radiant Volley and Solar Snare both outrange Mourning Mist (700). Yorick has no gap-closer at all, so the early levels belong to her and the lane only flips once Dark Procession plus a full grave stack exist. Level 6 is genuinely even, not a Mel win, because Eulogy of the Isles raises Walkers off her wave.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Mel, Mel, Mel, Skill, Yorick, Yorick across win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side, ratings inverted from the mirror's 5/7/6/6/5/4/3 to 5/3/4/4/5/6/7. whys[0..6] and phases[0..6].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text gave no cooldown numbers and phases[4] read Level 6 as a Mel win.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles (160/130/100s) is the point the lane stops being a poke lane — the Maiden raises Walkers from her wave and holds the wave for you. Golden Eclipse (120/100/80s) offsets it, so 6 is even rather than hers.
audit.corrected: phases[4] flipped to Skill and its why names Eulogy of the Isles' Walker-raising against Golden Eclipse. phases[5] and phases[6] keyed to Trinity Force and Rebuttal's 26s rank-5 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Rebuttal (W) blanking Mourning Mist (E) — was never stated, and no real cooldown numbers appeared anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is a thrown globule (projectile flag matches Riot's text); Rebuttal reflects projectiles and prevents damage for its duration on 38/35/33/29/26s. Losing the mark means the ghouls do not sprint at her, which is the whole Yorick pattern. Conversely Rebuttal is one 250-range bubble on a long cooldown and cannot stop a Dark Procession cage or the Walker swarm behind it, so cage first and mark after it drops. Searing Brilliance loads her next auto with bonus bolts after any spell cast — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Solar Snare's 1000-range root on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s named as the tracked cooldown; Rebuttal named as the projectile reflect that blanks Mourning Mist with 'cage first, mark second'; Searing Brilliance named as the auto wind-up tell. Yorick's kit file tags Mourning Mist with a 'dash' flag — Riot's description gives no movement to Yorick at all (the move speed goes to his summoned units toward the mark), so no dash is asserted anywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (sequencingCues: 0).
audit.why: Solar Snare is up roughly every 10s while Dark Procession is 16s at rank 3 — the player needs the actual numbers to know which side of the trade window they are on.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, winCon and report[5].t now carry the real numbers and an explicit ordering rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mel was repeatedly referred to as 'he'/'him' in tldr, winCon, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late and dontsFull[2].
audit.why: Mel is female; the page reads as machine-generated when the pronoun is wrong.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every edited field.
